prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 行标题 · 年度目标拆解 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "目标" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 108px
  col 2: header "负责人" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 3: header "截止" · longest unbreakable word 26px · one-line width 44px
  col 4: header "关键结果" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 541px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"将年度目标与负责人、截止日期和可衡量的关键结果对应起来，便于跟踪落实。","reading":"读者先按目标定位一行，再横向查看负责人、截止日期和关键结果；也可纵向比较各目标的责任人和时间安排。","groups":["目标与关键结果共同说明要达成什么及如何衡量，应保持清晰的行对应关系。","负责人与截止日期都是简短的执行信息，适合并列扫描，并应尽量完整显示。"],"keep_intact":["负责人姓名","截止日期及其连字符","关键结果中的数字、百分比和英文缩写"],"may_wrap":["目标名称可按中文语义自然换行，但应保持每行目标容易辨认。","关键结果是较长的描述性文字，可自然换行；目标名称也可利用这些文字形成的行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [75, 67, 65, 152] · table 360×415px · row heights [36, 129, 83, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [86, 67, 65, 141] · table 360×415px · row heights [36, 129, 83, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [70, 67, 65, 157] · table 360×415px · row heights [36, 129, 83, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"负责人和日期完整，执行信息便于纵向比较；关键结果有足够空间，行与行之间的对应关系清楚。","problems":"目标名称较窄，“客户满意度提升”被分成三行，末尾单字显得零碎，削弱了行标题的辨识度。","cause":"目标列为75px，扣除内边距和边框后仅有54px可排文字；关键结果列占152px。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"目标列更宽，目标名称更容易辨认，“客户满意度提升”缩为两行；负责人和日期仍完整，整体行高也没有增加。","problems":"关键结果换行更频繁，部分语句的短行和断行位置略显零碎，阅读节奏不如较宽的结果列流畅。","cause":"目标列增至86px，相应地将关键结果列压至141px，文字可用宽度减少。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"关键结果列最宽，长描述的行长较舒展；负责人、日期和数字保持完整。","problems":"目标列明显偏窄，多个目标名称被拆成短行，“客户满意度提升”末行只剩一个字；结果列增宽也没有降低表格总高度。","cause":"目标列仅70px，扣除内边距和边框后可排文字宽度为49px；关键结果列为157px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[82,67,65,145],"change":"以r2B为基础，将目标列缩小4px并交给关键结果列，尝试保留较易辨认的目标名称，同时改善长描述的断行。"},{"name":"goal-priority","widths":[90,67,65,137],"change":"进一步加宽目标列，测试行标题是否能获得更自然的断行，并检查关键结果列收窄后的阅读代价。"},{"name":"result-priority","widths":[80,67,65,147],"change":"在两类主要内容之间选择另一处折中，测试目标列略宽于r2A时能否减少零碎换行，同时为关键结果保留更多空间。"}]}
